Name: Prowler.CAR.Scavenger
Description: Apex Prowler reactive skin (Scavenger, full evolution) on the CAR: native Prowler first-person animations on the stock CAR skeleton, coil drum that turns one chamber per shot (client script + pose parameter) and the full-auto Prowler fire sound. No glow effects. Minimal weapon script pins stock model paths and the stock sound routing; crosshair/FOV/ADS/UI and gameplay inherit stock values.
